Class NewsReportScene

java.lang.Object
welcomescene.NewsReportScene
public class NewsReportScene extends Object
A scripted news-broadcast cut-scene that tells the backstory of Jurassic Tae through two animated TV reporters.

The scene is driven by the dialogue array, which is a sequential script containing:

  • Regular Thai text lines — displayed in the dialogue box and attributed to alternating reporters
  • "SOUND1" / "SOUND2" — trigger background music swaps
  • "BG1" / "BG2" / "BG3" — swap the background image and show/hide the reporter sprites

The player advances the script by clicking the mouse or pressing KeyCode.SPACE. Pressing KeyCode.F skips the entire scene and calls GameController.returnToMain() immediately.

Scene position in the intro flow: 

   IntroScene → ChongsamVideoScene → NewsReportScene → (lobby / main scene)

  • Constructor Details

    • NewsReportScene

      public NewsReportScene()
      Constructs and fully initialises the news-report cut-scene.

      Steps performed:

      • Loads the Thai pixel font (/fonts/thaipixel.ttf)
      • Creates the background ImageView starting with /news/bg1.png
      • Positions two Reporter sprite animations on the left and right sides of the screen
      • Builds a dialogue box at the bottom with a speaker-name label and a wrapping message label
      • Wires mouse-click and keyboard handlers to advance the script
      • Immediately runs the first line of the script so the scene is not blank on first display
      • Adds a blinking "Press F to Skip" hint label
